comments.author: Destry1
comments.body:
Can now (17th century) be made in Helder.
Stats:
+1 Fabric trading
Required Total Fame: 1000

Recipe is called Laced traditional hat manufacturing method
A method to make a traditional hat worn in the Low Countries area.
Requires sewing r8, 5 Silk Cloth and 10 Lace

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: Recipe can be found at the Resident (back of town) and it only produces the pink version. Female only

comments.author: Destry1
comments.body: The white version can be bought in Antwerp at the item shop. Also a Vemeer's Turban can be bought there.
